metadata.scope: Additional primary sources for numeric digital-benchmark calibration.

sources.title: Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models — official TH1.1 numerical results
sources.observation: Publishes per-model release dates, 50% and 80% software-task horizons, measurement bounds and frontier flags. The downloaded snapshot contains 26 observations across two task-suite versions.
sources.limitation: The dashboard is no longer actively maintained and warns that horizons above 16 hours cannot be measured reliably with this suite. Its tasks are bounded software, ML and cybersecurity problems; it does not publish 99% reliability horizons or occupation automation dates.
sources.forecastUse: Numerical source for the reproducible TH1.1 log2-horizon regression. Only comparable frontier observations within the stated measurement boundary are used in the primary fit.

sources.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons—a statistical look at the METR plot
sources.observation: Reanalyzes 228 tasks and 26 models with spline and item-response approaches, finding nonlinearities between human task duration and AI difficulty and improved predictive scoring under alternative models.
sources.limitation: A statistical reanalysis of the measured task distribution does not directly forecast future capabilities or entire occupations. It is a preprint, and its alternatives do not remove external-validity uncertainty.
sources.forecastUse: Motivates explicit model-form uncertainty; an exponential trend fit to published horizons is useful as a conditional benchmark extrapolation rather than a universal progress law.
